name: Sahuarita
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Sahuarita for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Letters to Santa) through December 19 (Gingerbread Houses 'N Family), with the Rancho Sahuarita Holiday Spectacular and the Clutch Cause Car Show and Toy Drive (both December 5), the Ballet Continental Nutcracker (December 4 to 6), Make Your Own Cards (December 9), Winterfest (December 12) and Lakeside Holiday Movie: Elf (December 18) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Sahuarita

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Sahuarita
  • 3 free events: Winterfest, Make Your Own Cards and Lakeside Holiday Movie: Elf
  • Meet Santa: Winterfest photos from 3 pm, Santa at the Clutch Cause Car Show and Toy Drive, and Letters to Santa
  • Shows: The Nutcracker by Ballet Continental at the Sahuarita District Auditorium, December 4 to 6
  • Parades and lights: the Light Parade and tree lighting at Winterfest (December 12)
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to December 19, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Sahuarita families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tucson, which covers the Downtown Parade of Lights and Festival, the Winterhaven Festival of Lights, The Nutcracker and Las Posadas Navidenas.
